--- title: "Firm registry enrichment of debtor CNPJs (RFB ref. 2026-03): what the pipeline does and what the API package contains" description: "Which Federal Revenue (RFB) attributes were linked to the debtor CNPJs, with what coverage, how natural persons are protected and what is missing before the upload to the API?" date: 2026-10-26 jupyter: python3 --- **Data:** the anonymised package `cnpj_enriquecido_ref2026-03` (API version, generated on 23 October 2026), the build's `coverage.csv` and the versioned manifest `data_manifests/cnpj_enrich/cnpj_enriquecido_2026-03.json`. Every number on this page is computed on the fly from these files. **What is shown:** aggregate counts only. No row per CNPJ, partner or hash, and every count below 5 is suppressed (shown as "<5"). **Status:** the package has been validated in a local DuckDB. See the last subsection. ## What the pipeline does | step | what it does | output | |---|---|---| | collect | Reads the distinct CNPJs of `DEBITO` (CEMEPI DuckDB, read-only), only the debtor CNPJ, tax and value columns | list of debtor CNPJs | | enrich (RFB 2026-03) | Joins the Federal Revenue open files (Companies, Establishments, Simples, domain tables), first by the 14-digit CNPJ and, if not found, by the root | registry, CNAE, size, legal nature, status, municipality, Simples/MEI | | partners | Reads the RFB `Socios*` files, in the local layer only | firm–partner links | | regime (ECF) | Joins the lists of tax regimes (actual, presumed and arbitrated profit, immune and exempt) by root and year | `regime_ultimo`, `regimes_por_ano` | | build | One row per debtor CNPJ, partitioned into 16 files | `cnpj_enriquecido` (local) | | anonymised export | `anonimizar` policy: a CNPJ linked to a natural person becomes an HMAC-SHA256 id with a salt kept outside the package; dates truncated; municipality generalised where k<5; partners only with decade of entry and age band | package for the API | ::: {#tbl-versao .cell tbl-cap='Version of the package, of the package\'s MANIFEST.json and of the manifest versioned in the repository.' execution_count=2} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: **Natural-person policy:** - **Pseudonym:** the CNPJ of a firm linked to a natural person (MEI, sole proprietor) and the natural-person partner become HMAC-SHA256 ids. The salt is kept outside the package, in an environment variable, and goes neither to git nor to the API. - **What is left out:** name, CPF, legal representative and exact date of entry into the partnership. For partners, only the decade of entry and the age band remain. - **Access:** the API is open only to the group's researchers, with a login and under PGE's NDA. - **Accepted risk:** in the combination "age band × municipality × CNAE", which can be obtained from the firm's CNPJ, about 38% of natural persons are in cells with k<5. The risk was accepted by Étore because access is restricted. In the generalised versions (state × CNAE section) the share falls below 1%. Combinations with more attributes (legal nature, size, start year, status or the role within the firm) have k<5 for a large share of rows. Access is therefore restricted to researchers and there is no public release. ## API package schema ::: {#tbl-esquema-socios .cell tbl-cap='Columns of socios_vinculos (those of cnpj_enriquecido are in the completeness table above).' execution_count=17} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=17} ```{=html}
